record.paper_title: Bounded compact and dual compact approximation properties of Hardy spaces: new results and open problems
record.context_brief: Exact norm of the backward shift on H^p
record.original_question: For each 1 ≤ p < ∞, determine the exact operator norm of the backward shift operator B on the Hardy space H^p, where B is defined by (Bf)(e^{iθ}) = e^{-iθ}(f(e^{iθ}) - ˆf(0)). Equivalently, determine the exact norm of I - K_0 on H^p.

evidence.quote: Open problem 5.4. Let 1 ≤ p < ∞. Find the exact value of the norm kBkB(Hp) of the backward shift operator.
Clearly, |Bf| = |(I − K0)f| => kBfkHp = k(I − K0)fkHp for all f ∈ Hp => kBkB(Hp) = kI − K0kB(Hp).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{T} = \{e^{i\theta} : \theta \in [0, 2\pi)\}$ denote the unit circle, and for $1 \le p < \infty$ let $H^p$ denote the Hardy space of analytic functions on the open unit disk whose boundary values lie in $L^p(\mathbb{T})$, equipped with the norm
$$\|f\|_{H^p} = \left(\frac{1}{2\pi}\int_0^{2\pi} |f(e^{i\theta})|^p\, d\theta\right)^{1/p}.$$
For $f \in H^p$ with Fourier series $f(e^{i\theta}) \sim \sum_{n\ge 0} \hat f(n) e^{in\theta}$, define the backward shift operator $B : H^p \to H^p$ by
$$(Bf)(e^{i\theta}) = e^{-i\theta}\bigl(f(e^{i\theta}) - \hat f(0)\bigr).$$
Equivalently, if $K_0 f = \hat f(0)$ denotes the rank-one projection onto the constants, then $|Bf| = |(I-K_0)f|$ on $\mathbb{T}$, so $\|B\|_{B(H^p)} = \|I - K_0\|_{B(H^p)}$.

Determine, for each $1 \le p < \infty$, the exact value of the operator norm $\|B\|_{B(H^p)}$.
artifact.status_search_result: The exact value of the operator norm of the backward shift on $H^p$ is known for $p=2$ (where it equals 1) but appears to remain open for general $1 \le p < \infty$, $p\ne 2$. Recent work provides only bounds, not exact values; see in particular Božin–Karapetrović's 2017 article giving sharp bounds on related Hardy/Bergman space norms.

status_evidence.title: Bounds on the Norm of the Backward Shift and Related Operators in Hardy and Bergman Spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Studies bounds for the backward shift operator on Hardy and Bergman spaces, providing estimates rather than exact values for the operator norm in $H^p$.
status_evidence.claim: The exact norm of the backward shift on $H^p$ for general $p$ is not given; only bounds are established.

status_evidence.title: The backward shift on H^p (W. T. Ross)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey article treating the backward shift on Hardy spaces; the exact operator norm for general $p$ is not stated.
status_evidence.claim: Standard reference on the backward shift; does not give an exact closed form for the norm on general $H^p$.
